project: Leonida Explorer - Neon Highway Minigame Exit Action
design_principles: Precise addition over broad refactoring: only add the requested 'Exit Game' action below existing Game Over action buttons without altering physics, scoring, canvas loops, or rewards
Neon Pink & Cyan/Purple Cyber-Retro Harmony: maintain the exact #FF2E97 (neon pink), #22E4F2 (cyan), #21113B / #120A24 (deep synthwave violet/obsidian) palette
Ergonomic Mobile Touch Sizing: minimum 48px touch target height (min-h-12) with full width, rounded pill styling, and clear contrast for iOS Safari, Android Chrome, and Desktop Web
Predictable in-app navigation: cleanly route back to '/arcade' (the minigame selection hub) via TanStack Router without reloading or exiting the main Leonida Explorer app

entry_surfaces./arcade: arcade hub with neon game cards, live coin balance, and high score indicators
entry_surfaces./arcade/highway: immersive 2.5D neon highway canvas with top HUD and centered Game Over modal stack

game_over_modal_stack.container_classes: w-full max-w-sm rounded-3xl border border-[#FF2E97]/70 bg-[#21113B] p-5 text-center shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(255,46,151,0.32)]

button_order.name: Play Again / Erneut spielen
button_order.classes: min-h-12 w-full rounded-full bg-primary font-bold text-primary-foreground shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(255,46,151,0.35)] transition-transform duration-100 active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2

button_order.name: Show Top 5 / Top 5 anzeigen
button_order.classes: min-h-12 w-full rounded-full border border-[#22E4F2]/60 font-semibold text-[#22E4F2] shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(34,228,242,0.15)] transition-transform duration-100 active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2

button_order.name: Exit Game / Spiel verlassen
button_order.classes: min-h-12 w-full rounded-full border border-[#FF2E97]/50 bg-[#2A1448]/80 font-semibold text-[#FFB3D9] hover:border-[#FF2E97] hover:text-white hover:bg-[#FF2E97]/20 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(255,46,151,0.15)] transition-all duration-150 active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2

motion.transitions: transition-transform 0.1s ease, transition-colors 0.15s ease, transition-shadow 0.15s ease

accessibility.contrast_ratio: Text '#FFB3D9' against '#21113B' exceeds 7.5:1 (well above WCAG AAA 7:1)
accessibility.aria_roles: role='dialog' on the Game Over container, descriptive labels and data-testid on every interactive button

instructions_to_main_agent: Inside the Game Over modal block (screen === 'over'), locate the button stack container containing 'highway-restart-button' and 'highway-leaderboard-button'.
Add the 'Exit Game' action directly below 'highway-leaderboard-button' using TanStack Router's `<Link to="/arcade">` (or an explicit button navigating to `/arcade`).
Use data-testid='highway-exit-button' for clear automated testing.
Use `{tr("Spiel verlassen")}` for bilingual translation (German default with English 'Exit Game' fallback in i18n-en.ts).

Apply styled neon pink/purple aesthetic with `min-h-12 w-full rounded-full border border-[#FF2E97]/50 bg-[#2A1448]/80 font-semibold text-[#FFB3D9] hover:border-[#FF2E97] hover:text-white hover:bg-[#FF2E97]/20 active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2`.
Include a matching Lucide icon such as `<ArrowLeft className="mr-2 inline h-4 w-4" />` or `<LogOut className="mr-2 inline h-4 w-4" />`.
DO NOT touch the game physics, canvas loops, reward submission API, or start/stop logic. Ensure everything else continues functioning smoothly.
